name: tessera
description: Compile TypeScript kernels to WebGPU via MLIR.

scripts.demo: npm run vendor && npm run build:artifacts && cp build/mlir/matmul_relu_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-mlir.wgsl && cp build/mlir/matmul_relu_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-mlir.json && cp build/direct/matmul_relu_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-direct.wgsl && cp build/direct/matmul_relu_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-direct.json && cp build/mlir/matmul_relu_ragged.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged.wgsl && cp build/mlir/matmul_relu_ragged.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged.json && cp build/direct/matmul_relu_ragged.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged-direct.wgsl && cp build/direct/matmul_relu_ragged.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged-direct.json && cp build/direct/softmax_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/softmax.wgsl && cp build/direct/softmax_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/softmax.json && cp build/direct/layernorm_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/layernorm.wgsl && cp build/direct/layernorm_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/layernorm.json && cp build/direct/matmul_bt_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-bt.wgsl && cp build/direct/matmul_bt_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-bt.json && cp build/direct/fused_softmax_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/fused-softmax.wgsl && cp build/direct/fused_softmax_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/fused-softmax.json && cp build/direct/nested_softmax_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/nested-softmax.wgsl && cp build/direct/nested_softmax_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/nested-softmax.json && node spike/wgsl-baseline/make-probes.mjs && node spike/wgsl-baseline/vendor.mjs --check && node spike/wgsl-baseline/check-typegpu-layout.mjs && echo '-> artifacts and probes rebuilt; open http://localhost:8080/'
scripts.build:artifacts: npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul.kernel.ts -o build/direct && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul.kernel.ts -o build/mlir --backend=mlir && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul-ragged.kernel.ts -o build/direct && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul-ragged.kernel.ts -o build/mlir --backend=mlir && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/softmax.kernel.ts -o build/direct && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/layernorm.kernel.ts -o build/direct && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul-bt.kernel.ts -o build/direct && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/fused-softmax.kernel.ts -o build/direct && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/twoaxis.kernel.ts -o build/direct && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/nested-softmax.kernel.ts -o build/direct
